content:
evan: Quick ask — can someone run a smoke + regression bench for citrine-6b-qlite (FP16 with 4-bit quant fallback) at seq=512, batches 1/4/8? Need p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec vs production-citrine-6b. Prefer results by EOD. Thanks.
priyanka: I can take this. Which hw do you want? A100-80g or 40g? Also do you want KV-cache cold vs warm?
mica: I can spin it up on canary pool (A100-80g). Will include cold vs warm kv and a steady-state 5m run.
ev an: (typo) meant evan :) Evan: A100-80g is perfect. Include a 2k prefix warmup + steady-state 5m. Add --kv-eviction-check if easy.
mica: Kicked off on canary-a100-80g-03. Command I used: ```./bench/run --model citrine-6b-qlite --seq 512 --batches 1,4,8 --dur 300 --kv-warm true --kv-eviction-check true --compare production-citrine-6b```
bench-bot: job 98765 queued on canary-a100-80g-03 — logs: https://ci.internal/bench/98765 (started)
mica: Interim quick numbers (first 60s sample):
````
# citrine-6b-qlite (canary)  seq512
batch=1  p50=72ms  p95=155ms  p99=330ms  toks/s=430
batch=4  p50=220ms p95=540ms  p99=1.12s  toks/s=1580
````
mica: Baseline prod-citrine-6b (same host, same config): batch1 p50=66ms p95=132ms p99=285ms toks/s=455. So qlite shows small p95 regression but tokens/s roughly comparable. Memory usage down ~12% on this run.
priyanka: I'll run a 10m steady-state and a short long-tail P99 sweep. Will post full CSV to GCS.
jenna: heads-up — we saw eviction jitter in prior q-profiles. Thanks for --kv-eviction-check, that should catch it.
mica: Full results uploaded: https://gcs.internal/redwood/bench/98765/results.csv Summary pasted below for easy scan.
````
SUMMARY (steady 5m @ A100-80g-03)
- citrine-6b-qlite (quant fallback): batch1 p50=72ms p95=155ms p99=330ms toks/s=430 mem=~40GB
- production-citrine-6b:             batch1 p50=66ms p95=132ms p99=285ms toks/s=455 mem=~45GB
- Notes: kv-cache warm reduced p99 by ~8% vs cold, eviction-check saw no anomalies.
````
ev an: This looks reasonable — perf hit is small and memory reduction is substantial. Plan: canary the model in prod low-traffic route next week, add quant-profile entry to model catalog, and open a PR for rollout policy. @priyanka can you own the PR and the canary run?
priyanka: Yep, will open PR today and schedule a canary for Tue morning. Will tag QA + SRE.
jenna: :thumbsup: if SRE wants to run an independent check, ping me and I can queue another run across a different AZ.
ev an: thanks all — great turnaround. Closing this thread after PR is up.
